notes: «قالا حدثنا شعبة»: Yahya and Abd al-Rahman both narrate from Shu'ba, so they form one level of co-transmitters
The gloss «- قال يحيى عن عبد الله بن أبي المجالد، وقال عبد الرحمن، عن ابن أبي المجالد -» gives the name at this place; the two forms are one man and the fuller form is written
«امترى ... فأرسلوني ... فسألته»: Ibn Abi al-Mujalid asks Ibn Abi Awfa, who answers and is the last link
